newsitem.title: UK: Tipco Asphalt prices $70 million convertible bond.
newsitem.headline: Tipco Asphalt prices $70 million convertible bond.

text.p: Tipco Asphalt Company Limited has priced its $70 million convertible bond due September 19, 2006, at 100.0 percent with a coupon of 2.75 percent, lead manager Paribas Capital Markets said.

The conversion premium is 13.1 percent, equal to 155 Baht. There are 163.71 shares per bond. The paper has a put option on September 19, 2001 at 132.564 percent to yield 150 basis points over five-year U.S. Treasuries. It is non-callable until September 19, 1998. Thereafter it is callable at par subject to 140 percent hurdle.
The exchange rate is fixed at 25.375 Baht per $1,000.
